hypothesis: Same-patch cross-variable attention before temporal encoding generalizes better than the exact same added block after encoding. Test placement, not an unsupported claim that channel independence is intrinsically invalid.
single_controlled_difference_between_arm: Cross-channel block position only; identical parameters, initialization, cached pretrain, numerical inputs, scaler, dropout value, optimizer groups, LR, loss, budgets and chronological selection. Dropout RNG ordering can differ because the block executes at a different location.

outer_gate.if_failed: Complete six internal runs without new outer inference, threshold changes, appended candidates or seeds
outer_gate.if_passed: Evaluate all six exact checkpoints once, including harmed folds; report both arms and all frozen controls

history_power_bins.scope: last historical observed power only; diagnostic partition, no sample deletion or routing

claim_scope: Exploratory numerical architecture ablation. No novel-method, causal-physics, information-ceiling or independent-confirmation claim. No NWP acquisition or reanalysis substitution.
